steps.label: Prompt
steps.text:
Make a 20-second product demo for [your product], square 1:1 at 1080x1080, from the "22-maker-map-globe" template in lumian2015/opus-5-5-video-templates (MIT, rendered with HyperFrames).

Setup: clone https://github.com/lumian2015/opus-5-5-video-templates into ~/.claude/skills/opus-5-5-video-templates, then run `npx hyperframes@0.8.96 doctor` and fix anything it reports (it needs Node.js 22 or newer, FFmpeg and Chrome).

The film, scene by scene:
1. logo pill becomes a 'Put me on the map' button, then a field where a handle is typed
2. an 'Is this you?' profile card; the tap turns it into a spinner, a check and an orange dot
3. 'You're on the map' with a ripple; the dot grows into a white globe
4. a dotted Earth swings west to the Americas and back while maker dots pop in and the counter climbs
5. the globe collapses into the dot, which opens into a '6 matches' pill and a list of people
6. a stats card with a sliding segmented control and rolling numbers
7. an event card where 'I'm going' turns orange and the count goes up
8. a search that types itself and returns three people, then the logo pill with the domain

Before you change anything, learn [your product] from [your product URL] and ask me only for what you cannot find: its name, what it does in one line, the copy each scene needs, and two or three brand colours as #rrggbb. The demo brand, names, prices, numbers, ratings and quotes are placeholders: replace every one with something true for my product, or remove it. Never ship a made-up number or testimonial.

Then:
1. `node ~/.claude/skills/opus-5-5-video-templates/scripts/new-video.mjs 22-maker-map-globe my-video`
2. `node ~/.claude/skills/opus-5-5-video-templates/scripts/vars.mjs my-video` to list the variables.
3. Write values.json, keeping each value close to its default's length and format (the same number of |-separated items, plain numbers where the default is a number), then apply it with `node ~/.claude/skills/opus-5-5-video-templates/scripts/vars.mjs my-video values.json`.
4. `cd my-video && npx hyperframes@0.8.96 snapshot --at 1,7,13,19`, look at every frame, and fix any text that overflows or any colour that is hard to read.
5. `npx hyperframes@0.8.96 render -f 60 -q high -w 4 -o out.mp4`, then watch it through once before you hand it over.

Template notes: Every state is one shape: S holds each state's size, corner radius (-1 = fully round) and colour, M holds the morph timings, colour windows and blank beats, and each state's contents cross-fade and squash with the shape. Where the globe swings is set by GK (centre longitude/latitude over time); the maker dots cluster around the CITIES list. homeLat/homeLon place your dot. Avatars are gradient circles with initials; swap in real photos only with permission.
